item.title: 3rd Annual Parklane Hobbies Mini-Z Cup Race Announcement
item.description: Parklane Hobbies is hosting their 3rd Annual Mini-Z Cup Race on April 10th-12th. Find out more and join in on the action in Pottstown, Pennsylvania.

item.title: New 2026 TLR Teaser Photo
item.description: A teaser photo has been circulating TLR driver's Facebook pages today indicating the release of a new product on 2/12/26.

item.title: New Team Associated RC10 Model 24 Classic
item.description: The Team Associated RC10 Model 24 is a faithful, downsized tribute to one of the most iconic radio control buggies ever created.

item.title: Industry Analytics: Weekly Stats [2/4 - 2/11]
item.description: This week over 20,000 entries were taken into the #LiveTimeScoring program, over 30% of the entries were logged for 1/10th scale off-road followed by 21% for dirt oval, and 11% for 1/10th scale electric on-road. Check out all the data here. #Industry

item.title: Top25rc Rankings Post 2026 Montpellier GP
item.description: The Top25RC rankings have been updated to reflect Montpellier 2026. Canas taking the win has allowed him to close the gap on the #1 rankings.

item.title: New Avid RC 22X Triad Evo Slipper and Direct Drive Options
item.description: Avid RC has brought their ultra popular Triad Evo Slipper Setup and Triad Direct Drive Setup options to the TLR 22X line of 2wd buggies.

item.title: New Team Xray X4'26 Glass Fiber Upper Decks
item.description: These specially made Team Xray X4'26 upper decks from flexible & durable glass fiber material increases the flex of the car and improves handling on low- to medium traction tracks.

item.title: Lariviere Joins Reedy Power Product Development and Technical Support Team
item.description: Reedy is excited to announce multi time ROAR Spec National Champion Doug Lariviere has joined the Reedy team for 2026 and beyond.

item.title: New TLR 22X-4 2.0 1/10th 4wd Buggy Kits [VIDEO]
item.description: Introducing the all new TLR 22X-4 2.0 Race Kit, built from the lessons of the revolutionary 22 series and engineered for the next era of electric racing dominance on today’s high grip tracks.
